## Description {#details}

<p>Iterator for locations and the values they contain.</p>


<p>Dereferencing produces a struct/pair containing the <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/livedebugvalues/locidx">LocIdx</a> key for this location, and a reference to the value currently stored. Simplifies the process of seeking a particular location.</p>


<p>Definition at line 762 of file <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/files/lib/lib/codegen/lib/codegen/livedebugvalues/instrrefbasedimpl-h">InstrRefBasedImpl.h</a>.</p>
